summary: Accept both Fabric fleet protocol names at fleet identity checks

replay.detail: No claim history or projection changes.

schema.detail: Fleet settings and handshake shapes are unchanged.

rules.detail: Fleet, sponsor, gateway and member identity checks remain required.

compatibility.detail: Fleet protocol readers accept st3/fleet/<fleet> and fractal/fleet/<fleet> for the same fleet. Default writers and adapter grants still use st3/fleet/<fleet>; exposure and dial behavior are unchanged. Saved protocol values retain their original spelling.

recovery.detail: This change does not rewrite persisted protocol names or signed endpoint history.
